name: Unsigned Varchenko Determinant
definition: For a finite partial cube $G$ with one variable $x_e$ per $\Theta$-class, set $\mathsf V_G(u,v)=\prod_{e\in S(u,v)}x_e$, where $S(u,v)$ is the set of classes separating $u$ and $v$, and take its determinant.
codomain: Multivariate integer polynomials, up to relabeling of class variables
comments: The determinant is independent of vertex order and of choices in a minimal cube embedding, up to variable relabeling.
